column1: # systems.tsv (harbor#1436, #1423 T18.13) - the systems `harbor <system> <verb>` dispatches, by register and not by code.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. bin/harbor's verb list is frozen (contracts/cli.md) and a sibling's CLI was reachable only through
# a script that wrapped one verb of it (`harbor ship`). A system is a row here: its verbs, and what runs each. A new system is a
# row, not an edit to bin/harbor. `sh bin/scope-system.sh tree` renders the table as the command tree; the private layer's
# systems.tsv (a workload's own system, which core cannot name) is read after this one and may only add rows.
# COLUMNS  system <TAB> verb <TAB> run <TAB> json <TAB> summary
#   system   the word after `harbor`; not one of harbor's own verbs (lint scope.system-register)
#   verb     the word after the system, or * for every verb the system's own CLI answers: they are passed through whole
#   run      bin:<script> [fixed words]  a harbor script beside the dispatcher, or
#            tool:<VAR> [fixed words]    the executable the roots table's <VAR> names (scope-roots.sh --get), never reimplemented
#   json     yes when the command takes --json, otherwise no
